verdict.rationale: Hugging Face ships its own programmatic surfaces that cover many UI actions. The hf CLI and huggingface_hub library list models, download snapshots, upload files to repos and run jobs. A public OpenAPI spec is served, and the inference playground lets users switch between UI view and code snippets. Nothing documents that the API matches everything the UI can do; settings, usage dashboards and Spaces/Endpoints deployment are described as UI or 'a few clicks' flows. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of account settings and usage reporting, documented API flows for Spaces and Inference Endpoints deployment, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
